sections.heading: Proposal Summary
sections.text: This proposal, SYN-SYNCP000150-P1, was presented by MERCK & COMPANY (the Supplier) to Silver Oak Medical Group 150 on October 4, 2025.

sections.heading: Supplier Concession
sections.text: Supplier concession: an administrative fee of 2.25%.

sections.heading: Supplier Request
sections.text: Supplier request: a HPV share floor of 60%.

sections.heading: Proposal Status
sections.text: Status of this proposal: awaiting a Customer decision.
